import nuke from NukeFaceTrack import core, ui import importlib
# Reload to ensure Nuke sees the new Class and Functions importlib.reload(core) importlib.reload(ui)
def run_tool(): # Identify the selected node try: target_node = nuke.selectedNode() except ValueError: nuke.message("Please select a Read node first.") return
# Initialize the UI p = FaceTrackUI(target_node)
if p.showModalDialog(): # Initialize the processor here to fix the NameError processor = FaceProcessor()
# Get frame range from UI fr = nuke.FrameRange(p.range.value())
# Get smoothing value from UI smooth_val = p.smooth.value()
# Run the analysis session = processor.run_range(target_node, fr.first(), fr.last())
# Create the stabilized Transform and Roto if session: create_all_tools(session, target_node, smooth_val) else: nuke.message("No face data was captured.") run_tool()
